method_description: Morphological Planform Method (MPM) implemented in sandplover.  Original method after Geleynse, N., et al. Characterization of  river delta shorelines. Geophysical research letters 39.17 (2012).
notes: Tool run with default parameters. Shoreline extracted along 0.75 contour.  Contour converted into line by sandplover `compute_shoreline_length` tool. See software documentation for additional details.

method_description: Opening Angle Method (OAM) implemented in sandplover.  Original method after Shaw, John B., et al. An  image-based method for shoreline mapping on complex  coasts. Geophysical Research Letters 35.12 (2008).
notes: Tool run with default parameters. Shoreline extracted along 45 degree contour.  Contour converted into line by sandplover `compute_shoreline_length` tool. See software documentation for additional details.
